mission: Enable business-driven services and solutions that provide a secure and frictionless digital government experience for North Carolinians.

goals.title: Technology and data standards
goals.description: Set clear standards for the technology and data services used by the state. Standards need to be addressed in the areas of transparency, accountability, performance, fairness, etc.

goals.title: AI readiness and infrastructure
goals.description: Position the state to make good use of new technologies such as AI by ensuring infrastructure is in place for implementation and subsequent scaling of AI use. Make sure that agencies statewide are comfortable using AI and are up-to-date with ethical and security concerns involving the technology.

goals.title: Statewide AI ecosystem and collaboration
goals.description: Achieve scale by developing a statewide AI ecosystem by having the DIT act as a partner that bridges public agencies. Together a more united system would have less redundancy, be more streamlined, and allow for greater collaboration.

goals.title: Cybersecurity
goals.description: Enhance NC's cybersecurity through constant monitoring, establishing mechanisms of accountability, and partnerships with other levels of government.

goals.title: Technology workforce
goals.description: Replace retiring workers in the agency with a wave of new, innovative workers by establishing new career pathways and modernizing the job to make it more desirable.
